text:
Alex Chen: Hey team — candidate for SWE2 booked Tue 3/24 10:30am PT. Panel needed: backend, infra, system design, behavioral. Rebecca already created the req. Can someone cover backend if Priya is OOO that morning?
Rebecca (recruiter): @Alex Chen — Priya marked OOO that day in 3/24. Candidate preferred morning. I can try to move to 1:30pm PT but candidate said morning is best. Any swaps possible? :calendar:
Samir Patel: I can cover backend at 10:30 if we keep it. Free then.
Maria Gomez: I can do 10:30 too but afternoon is easier for me. Quick rubric Q: for system design do we score 1-5 or pass/fail?
Alex Chen: Use the 1-5 scale from the rubric — we want granularity. Focus notes on architecture, tradeoffs, and scalability. Example snippet for scoring to keep consistent:
```rubric
system_design: {
  score_scale: "1-5",
  focus: ["architecture", "scalability", "tradeoffs"],
  pass_threshold: "4"
}
```
Priya Singh: If it's 1-5 then I can swap with Samir and take afternoon, but I'm out in the morning. If candidate must have morning, Samir taking backend works.
Rebecca (recruiter): Candidate prefers morning; @Jamal Kaur any chance you can take the infra slot at 10:30?
Jamal Kaur: Yep I can do 10:30. Happy to cover infra + ops questions. What should I probe specifically?
Alex Chen: Keep infra probes focused: latency budgets, caching strategies, monitoring/alerting tradeoffs. 15m system design, 20m coding, 10m behavioral. Use the rubric link I posted earlier. After interview, please submit debrief in Greenhouse within 48h. :memo:
Samir Patel: Sounds good — I’ll take backend if Priya can’t. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: Small rubric clarification: when giving a 3 for system design, add one-line note on missing edge cases or unclear tradeoffs. Example template: \"score 3 — solid approach but missed caching & durability tradeoffs; limited scaling plan.\"
Rebecca (recruiter): I’ll update invites to assign Samir, Maria, Jamal and add the interviewer prep doc + rubric link. Will also include a reminder to complete debrief within 48h.
Alex Chen: Thanks — can you also add a short debrief checklist to the invite (latency, correctness, design tradeoffs, communication)? That helps TLs reconcile scores.
Rebecca (recruiter): Will do, updating now. Invites will show explicit roles (backend, infra, design).
System Bot: Reminder scheduled: Post-interview debrief form due within 48 hours — https://greenhouse.example/debrief/12345
Jamal Kaur: Got the invite. I’ll review the prep doc tonight.
Priya Singh: Thanks for the swap options — if anything changes ping me, I can flex.
Alex Chen: Great coordination — final panel = Samir (backend), Maria (coding/behavior), Jamal (infra/design). Rebecca, confirm when calendar + prep sent.
Rebecca (recruiter): Confirmed — invites updated at 10:45am PT, prep doc attached, debrief link included. I’ll ping again after the loop. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: Awesome — quick reminder to everyone: put any rubric disagreements in this thread so I can adjudicate before TL sync. Appreciate it!"
